runners_data.name: Pocket Jacks

runners_data.name: Kilmac Air

runners_data.name: Dawn Flame

runners_data.name: Gosford Queen

races.paceDynamic: Caitouna is the only confirmed front runner in this 21-runner handicap and will likely dictate terms unopposed from the off. With most of the field showing hold-up or midfield tendencies, she should get an easy lead through comfortable fractions over 6½f. The lack of pace pressure means the race will likely become a sprint from the 2f pole, with late-running types getting first run on a potentially strung-out leader. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers who can quicken, while the lone leader faces a difficult task against fresh closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Surge Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Caitouna sets uncontested fractions and multiple hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final 2f as fresh closers swamp the tiring leader with superior finishing kicks. Hold-up specialists will benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent runner like Coincidental Glory or Amerilis tracks Caitouna closely
scenarios.body: The tracker will have first run on the leader while avoiding the traffic problems facing hold-up horses. They'll strike early in the straight before the pack arrives.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Caitouna Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground takes more out of the closers than expected
scenarios.body: Caitouna's uncontested lead becomes a winning advantage as tired horses fail to close on testing ground. Her sustained galloping style suits the conditions better than stop-start tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos in Running
scenarios.trigger: If significant interference occurs in the home straight with 21 runners
scenarios.body: The pace advantage becomes irrelevant as luck in running determines the outcome. Horses drawn wider or ridden for clear water will benefit from avoiding trouble.

watchPoints.text: Caitouna could get soft fractions as the lone leader but faces being swamped by superior numbers in the straight
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 21 runners - hold-up horses need clear passage to utilise finishing kicks
Meriden's five-day turnaround after impressive 7f win could see further improvement from this progressive type
Ground conditions may deteriorate through the card - later runners could face more testing conditions than "good to yielding" suggests
Slattery yard runs both Cisterna and Aurora Mist - market support may indicate which is preferred

races.paceDynamic: Kula Bula Boyo will lead this field uncontested with The Piper's Call likely to track behind in second. With no other confirmed pace pressers and 18 largely inexperienced runners, this sets up as a steady gallop that will quicken late. The lack of early pace and tactical speed will create a sprint finish over the final 2f as the field bunches up. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with a finishing kick who can position off the moderate tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout with Kula Bula Boyo controlling from the front
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2f out where horses with finishing speed can unleash late runs from midfield or further back. Hold-up runners like Quinta Girl, Sancerre Rock and Trek Home benefit most from this patient tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Kula Bula Boyo goes very slowly and The Piper's Call doesn't apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race crawls to the turn before exploding into a mad dash where only horses with genuine acceleration can win. The newcomers with unknown speed become dangerous as proven moderate performers get swamped.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Form
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo stays even but fair allowing proven form to shine through
scenarios.body: The steadier rhythm helps horses show their true ability without tactical complications compromising the outcome. The Piper's Call's superior form figures and Quinta Girl's best effort at two become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Rank Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If The Piper's Call moves up to challenge Kula Bula Boyo approaching the turn
scenarios.body: A genuine pace develops that stretches the field and prevents a cavalry charge finish. Prominent racers and those with tactical speed benefit while pure hold-up horses find themselves too far back.

watchPoints.text: Kula Bula Boyo could go too slowly early if unchallenged and set up a messy sprint finish
The Piper's Call must overcome 333 days since last run but has shown best form of experienced runners
Starborn Legend represents Joseph O'Brien who has 4 winners from 59 runners recently but excels with newcomers
Several expensive newcomers like Ask Me Again and Forbidden could be well-handicapped by the market
Going has been consistent as Good To Yielding all day which should suit most runners without major concerns

runners_data.name: Tornado Kiss
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid form but trainer/jockey combination suggests limited expectations today
runners_data.comment: C&D maiden winner, no joy in listed company last twice, could go well on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Beat Bad Boy Rizz in Cork 2yo maiden but twice safely held in Listed company, most recently didn't give his true running (upset in stalls) when never sighted behind Allsortz on handicap debut at Cork (soft); bit to prove now.

runners_data.name: Focaccia
runners_data.note: Claiming apprentice Orla Tynan takes valuable weight off but horse lacks the class for this level
runners_data.comment: Third in 6f Curragh maiden in March; has flashed tail both starts
runners_data.spotlight: Promising debut third in 6f maiden here in March; out of depth in Listed class next time, recent AW second (Cool Azul third) was her best effort yet; tailflasher; cheekpieces now tried on handicap debut (3lb wrong).

runners_data.name: Shadow Run
runners_data.note: Returns from a 60-day absence which raises questions about readiness despite previous promise
runners_data.spotlight: Definite step in the right direction on seasonal return at Naas in March when beaten a neck (every chance) on soft but didn't get home on similar ground in Cork rated event following month; blinkers replaced by visor here; 4lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Fox In Flight
runners_data.note: Hold-up style may not suit if the pace stays steady throughout the entire race
runners_data.comment: 5f Dundalk maiden winner, off since December, handicap debut, McAteer deserts
runners_data.spotlight: Dundalk maiden win came at this trip over the winter, later third to Sovereign Cry in conditions event at same track; soft ground may not have suited on last month's return when last of eight behind stablemate Allsortz on handicap debut at Cork; hard to see him reversing Cork form with several of these.

runners_data.name: Sovereign Cry
runners_data.note: AW specialist whose turf form remains questionable despite recent Dundalk success
runners_data.comment: Won here last season but the glaring concern is his recent heavy defeat at Naas
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive profile on the AW last season but too keen when soundly beaten on turf/seasonal debut at Naas last month; better back at Dundalk since but doubts remain back on turf, especially if ground eases.

runners_data.name: Sparky Sparky
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed promise in Cork maiden but inconsistent efforts since raise doubts
runners_data.comment: Has only run on soft turf; first two runs were fine; 10-11 fav  when bombed out at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: Standout run on seasonal return when saying on third behind a smart type in Cork maiden (5f, soft) in April; ran no sort of race there last month before just fair fourth on Dundalk AW last week (3l off Cool Azul) when tried in a tongue-tie; nicely-weighted on best form and rider's claim a bonus on handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Ipanema Queen is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the front without meaningful pressure early. Cool Azul, Real Encounter, Allsortz, and Tornado Kiss will track the leader in a prominent group, but none are aggressive enough to force a strong gallop over 5f on softer ground. The pace will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay bunched turning for home before a sprint finish develops. This moderate early pace clearly favours prominent runners who can position close and kick, while hold-up horses like Amiata and Bad Boy Rizz face a tactical disadvantage in a slowly-run sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Ipanema Queen sets uncontested fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The patient pace allows prominent runners to settle in ideal striking positions before unleashing their finishing kicks. Horses like Real Encounter and Allsortz get the perfect scenario to showcase their speed from good positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Room
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group goes too early or creates gaps late
scenarios.body: The patient early pace gives hold-up horses like Amiata and Bad Boy Rizz time to work into contention. Their superior finishing speed tells when they find clear runs in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ipanema Queen Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite maintains her kick after setting the pace
scenarios.body: Her class advantage shows as she quickens away from her own moderate tempo. The lack of early pressure leaves enough in reserve for a decisive move that the prominent trackers cannot match.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding leaves everyone with too much to do
scenarios.body: The conservative early pace becomes a crawl, turning into a pure sprint finish where the best raw speed wins. Form horses struggle as the race becomes a lottery decided by who gets the clearest passage.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Ipanema Queen to get an easy lead - if uncontested she becomes very dangerous despite the layoff
Monitor how aggressively the prominent group positions early - passive tactics will favour the front-runner
Check if Bad Boy Rizz and Amiata can secure clear runs late as hold-up horses need luck in slowly-run sprints
Observe Real Encounter's early positioning as his proven 5f form makes him the main threat to the favourite
Watch for any market moves on Allsortz who showed improvement when winning last time at this distance

races.name: Sky Bet Race To The Ebor Handicap

runners_data.name: Holy See
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form, benefits from Jamie Orr's 7lb claim and looks well-treated off 98
runners_data.comment: French AW wins over shorter; handles ground, trip an unknown on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Useful AW winner in France over 1m/1m1f; campaigned mainly over hurdles by current yard, winning Limerick novice on heavy over Christmas; fine first effort on the Flat for current yard when winning 1m4f Gowran handicap under today's rider in April (soft) under a positive ride; 5lb higher here but remains of interest.

runners_data.name: Tyson Fury
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 82-day break, needs the run but has strong staying credentials up to 2m
runners_data.spotlight: Wins have been at up to 2m (AW), winning claimer at Dundalk in March too; runner-up in ordinary maiden hurdles the last twice; can't be ruled out back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Yulia
runners_data.note: Prominent French import stepping up in trip, 31 days since last run should have her sharp for O'Brien
runners_data.comment: French import who stays considerably further than this, no luck in running on Irish debut
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins in France (on soft and AW); has won over 1m7f, and had never raced at under 1m4f until recent Irish debut at Sligo; unplaced favourite after starting slowly and meeting trouble in running (1m2f); returns to a more suitable trip.

runners_data.name: Poetic Sound
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form over the distance, Keane booking suggests strong chance
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 5yo goes well fresh and top-weight respected
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 1m4f in 2024 and began last season in form of his life over 1m6f at Navan, touched off in handicap and fine third in Listed contest; last month's 1m4f Leopardstown comeback run was encouraging, could well improve enough from that to play a major role here back at 1m6f.

runners_data.name: Emit
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter with Ryan Moore up, class advantage but carrying top weight of 140lbs
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent last season, going close in 1m2f Group 3 Gallinule Stakes here and later in year twice runner-up in Longchamp Group contests over 1m7f; first two runs this term at 1m6f were creditable, drop back 1m4f didn't suit latest; drops to handicap company and back to ideal trip.

runners_data.name: Too Bossy For Us
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 248-day layoff, needs this run badly for Mullins
runners_data.comment: Useful on Flat, struggled up in class since C&D maiden win, overlooked by Townend
runners_data.spotlight: Useful on the Flat, although sole win came back in 2024, narrowly beaten here over 2m last summer; equally talented hurdler, but some stiff tasks of late; market likely informative back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Factual Fact
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good current form, won last time out and handles the going well
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner who was closing on the winner in a 1m4f handicap at the Curragh in March
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner has done well since returning to the Flat, second here over 1m4f and handled better ground to win 2m1f Killarney amateur handicap last month under a positive ride; 4lb higher but could have more to offer off this low weight upped in grade.

runners_data.name: Granite Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 55-day break, good record fresh for Fahey
runners_data.comment: Three wins in 2024 and placed multiple times last term; made a decent comeback at Gowran
runners_data.spotlight: Showed good form in 2024 with a trio of wins from 1m2f-1m6f and runner-up in three of last four starts last term; plenty to take from seasonal return at Gowran in April when fourth to Holy See (1m4f, soft), rallying again late on; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Dawn Rising
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong staying form, 9-year-old veteran knows his job for O'Brien
runners_data.comment: Group 2 course winner at 2m, fine second in last year's Cesarewitch, inadequate trip here
runners_data.spotlight: No wins last season but strong form in defeat in big staying handicaps; fourth in the amateur handicap at Galway, fifth in the Irish Cesarewitch and signed off with a fine second in the Cesarewitch; recent run here was over an inadequate trip, more expected of here and seemingly McMonagle's pick.

runners_data.name: Tribal Star

runners_data.spotlight: Seen mostly on AW, including fourth of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m) last June; running well on AW this year and good effort back on turf at Chester last month, only fading late on over 2m3f; upped in grade here and could go well with rider's claim.

runners_data.name: En Or
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 227-day break, long losing run suggests he needs this outing
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time Flat winner but losing run goes back to December 2024; hurdling last winter without success, may need this comeback run.

runners_data.name: Perry Mason
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won here last month making all, proven at the track and distance
runners_data.comment: Has shown a liking for this track, suited by soft ground, would benefit from any easing
runners_data.spotlight: Was recording a third win at this track when scoring over 1m2f last month (good), making virtually all and just holding on; previously ran well over 1m4f, this his first attempt at this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Emit stands as the clear pace angle, likely to lead from the start with his front-running style and Ryan Moore's positive tactics. Holy See, Yulia, Poetic Sound and Perry Mason will provide prominent company but none are confirmed pace pressers. The moderate early gallop will allow the field to stay compact through the first mile, before quickening from the 3f pole. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, as the leaders will have plenty left for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace unfolds as expected with Emit setting steady fractions
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have too much finishing kick for the pace-setters who've been allowed an easy lead. Dawn Rising, Factual Fact and Tyson Fury can all produce devastating late surges when the race is run to suit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can secure ideal tracking positions behind Emit
scenarios.body: Holy See and Perry Mason can use their tactical speed to strike at the right moment before the hold-up horses get organised. Their prominent style allows them to avoid traffic problems while still having enough left to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Emit goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The tactical speed horses with prominent styles will have the crucial positioning advantage in a messy finish. Yulia and Granite Bay can quicken sharply when the real racing begins, leaving the hold-up horses with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Emit gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to organise a challenge
scenarios.body: Perry Mason showed at this track last month that front runners can succeed here when given rope. Emit has the class advantage and Ryan Moore's tactical nous to dictate terms throughout if allowed to cruise in front.

watchPoints.text: Emit could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions up front with the class to kick away
Holy See represents serious each-way value with the apprentice allowance and current form
Dawn Rising's hold-up style could be perfectly suited if this becomes a truly-run staying test
Too Bossy For Us needs watching in the market after such a long absence for Mullins
Factual Fact's recent winning form makes him dangerous from an each-way perspective

runners_data.name: Rosato

races.paceDynamic: Sommelier is the only confirmed front runner and will likely dictate proceedings with support from prominent racers Four Blondes, Salah Belle, Carrigans Grove, Dynamic Force and Irish Rumour. This creates a solid gallop but not frantic early pace given the lack of multiple pace pressers. The large field of 23 runners means positioning will be crucial, with the strong contingent of hold-up horses needing luck in running. This race shape clearly favors prominent racers who can track the pace and kick, as they avoid traffic problems while benefiting from a solid but sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace develops as expected with Sommelier leading and prominent horses tracking smoothly
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leaders while avoiding the traffic that will inevitably engulf the back markers in this large field. Horses like Four Blondes, Carrigans Grove and Kitty Bear are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Gets Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly or the prominent horses fail to kick when needed
scenarios.body: A well-positioned hold-up horse with racing room gets a clear run and benefits from the strong gallop. The sheer number of runners creates opportunities for those getting the right splits.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Sommelier gets away with soft fractions and the field fails to respond quickly enough
scenarios.body: The leader maintains a sustainable pace and has enough left to resist challenges, particularly with the claimer's allowance helping. The large field works in favor of the horse who avoids trouble by being in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sommelier goes too slow early and prominent horses are caught napping
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian allowing closers to make up enormous ground in the straight. This requires multiple pace misjudgments from the prominent brigade.

watchPoints.text: Sommelier must be watched for pace judgment as the lone leader - if he goes too slow early the race changes completely
Hugo's Girl and Carrigans Grove both have excellent recent course form and are drawn to get good positions
Traffic will be crucial with 23 runners - any hold-up horse getting a clear run becomes dangerous late
Four Blondes has the form and tactical position to benefit from tracking Sommelier's pace
Jon Riggens' experience at this course over similar distances makes him a threat if getting racing room
